items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: You look out in the audience, and there’s Hamp.

Yeah. But the fellow that had him and made him come with them to hear me. That’s what they had – this was some of the band. Then, after he did that, we all went to dinner – lunch – a little lunch, whatever. We got to talking. I met Gladys.
